summary: Added durable launcher process identity, runtime truth classification, detached/orphaned PreviewSession propagation, UI control gating, and direct managed-wrapper fail-closed behavior for detached launch records.
control_boundaries: Stop authority remains tied to an attached live subprocess handle.
Persisted PID identity is retained as evidence only and does not grant process-control authority.
Detached and orphaned launcher records are visible in app preview state, but managed open, instrumented preview, diagnostics, and stop affordances are withheld.
Direct managed-wrapper URL rendering fails closed for detached or orphaned records and does not embed stop tokens, direct loopback URLs, iframe preview, or pagehide stop behavior.

sidecar_review.finding: Verifier found that detached/orphaned records could still render the managed open wrapper by direct URL. The issue was repaired before this receipt: payload open_href and instrumented_open_href now require managed preview availability, and build_project_launcher_open_html fails closed for non-controlled records.

validation.note: Vite emitted the existing large chunk warning only.
